**In one line**: Google is reported to be backing Anthropic's build-out of an AI data center in Texas, said to be worth roughly $15 billion.

### Key points
- Per a report from financial-analysis outlet simplywall.st, the project is said to be worth around $15 billion.
- The plan reportedly centers on securing a large data center in Texas for Anthropic's AI compute needs.
- Google is already a major investor and cloud partner to Anthropic, and the move is read as a deepening of that infrastructure tie.

### Why it matters
Training and serving frontier models demands enormous compute. A data-center investment on this scale would strengthen Anthropic's own capacity as it competes with rivals like OpenAI and Google, and it reflects a broader pattern of big tech firms anchoring themselves to specific AI labs through infrastructure commitments.
